close_reason: Implemented handle_calendar_event_parse: parses blobIds, calls parse_calendar_event_blobs (default puts all in notParsable); registered as CalendarEvent/parse; 2 tests; 26 total pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** CalendarEvent/parse handler is entirely missing from crate-jmap-calendars-server. Draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §5.13.

**Algorithm:**
1. Add ParseResult struct to backend.rs:
   pub struct ParseResult {
       pub parsed: HashMap<Id, Vec<CalendarEvent>>,
       pub not_found: Vec<Id>,
       pub not_parsable: Vec<Id>,
   }
2. Add to CalendarsBackend:
   fn parse_calendar_event_blobs(&self, account_id: &Id, blob_ids: &[Id], properties: Option<&[String]>) -> impl Future<Output = Result<ParseResult, Self::Error>> + Send;
   Default impl: all blobs in not_parsable.
3. Implement handle_calendar_event_parse in event.rs:
   - Parse accountId, blobIds, properties.
   - Check account exists.
   - Call backend.parse_calendar_event_blobs.
   - Build response: accountId, parsed (null if empty), notFound, notParsable.
4. Register CalendarEvent/parse in register_calendars_handlers.
5. Export from lib.rs.
6. Update smoke test from 18 to 19 methods.

**Tests:**
- Known blobIds → in parsed map.
- Unknown blobIds → in notFound.
- Unparseable blobs → in notParsable.
- properties filtering respected.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- CalendarEvent/parse registered and returns non-unknownMethod.
- cargo test -p jmap-calendars-server exits 0.
title: Implement CalendarEvent/parse handler (§5.13)
